commercial.name: Commercial Segmentation
commercial.summary: Commercial operates as a separate unit by Nov 20, stabilizes by Dec 11, and has automation requirements with the Tech team by Dec 18.

p1.goal: Dedicated Commercial cleaners, communication channels, trackers and KPIs.
p1.name: Separate Commercial from Residential

p2.goal: Client check-ins and day-to-day processes in place.
p2.name: Stabilize Commercial processes

p3.goal: Automation requirements accepted by the Tech team.
p3.name: Simplify and automate

i11.solution: List all necessary KPIs for the business unit with the formula and purpose of each KPI
i11.title: Commercial KPIs

checklist.text: Move every partner email to follow personal email
Standardize workflow for cleaner changes and quality concerns

i21.outcome: Every partner is on the schedule and the workflow is in use
i21.problem: Service quality and consistency are slowly being compromised due to the lack of regular pulse checks, client check-in calls and a standard process or quality check.
i21.solution: Fixed check-in schedule. Every partner email follows personal email. Standard workflow for cleaner changes and quality concerns.
i21.title: Client and owner check-ins

checklist.text: List all temporary programs and coverage needs
Plan coverage by existing Commercial cleaners, program by program
Set a cutover date for each program

i18.outcome: Every temporary program has an assigned cleaner plan and cutover date
i18.solution: List of all temporary programs and their coverage needs. Program-by-program plan to cover them with existing Commercial cleaners.
i18.title: Temporary program cutover strategy

i31.outcome: Tech team has accepted the requirements and given a build date
i31.solution: Desired outcome and workflow. Automation scope with the Tech team.
i31.title: Invoice reconciliation

checklist.text: Identify light and heavy booking days
Identify cleaners actually needed for Commercial, including temporary program coverage

i12.outcome: Core Commercial headcount is set. Segment Commercial cleaners fully, with an average 80% utilization rate for core Commercial cleaners.
i12.problem: Imbalanced numbers of commercial bookings in a week
i12.solution: Identify how many cleaners overlap with Residential and which days have few or many bookings. Identify how many cleaners are really needed for Commercial, including temporary program coverage.
i12.title: Cleaner overlap analysis

i17.problem: Workflow is currently under Sales initiatives and tasks
i17.solution: Program workflow moved from Sales to the Commercial Manager
i17.title: Temporary Homemaking handoff

checklist.text: Set up new Commercial phone line
Write the call SOP, including hybrid cleaner entry issues

i13.outcome: All Commercial clients and cleaners use the new channel, and hybrid cleaners call the Commercial Manager for every issue
i13.problem: Both accounts are in the same queue and phone number
i13.solution: Tech team and Leslie consult. New Commercial phone line and email. SOP making the Commercial Manager the first call for Commercial and hybrid cleaners, including hybrid cleaners with entry issues at Residential jobs. Announcement to clients and cleaners.
i13.title: Phone line, email and call SOP

i19.outcome: Backup is confirmed and the agreement is in place
i19.solution: Named backup. Written agreement to provide coverage for a minimum period during stabilization.
i19.title: Backup coverage for Jose

i23.outcome: Cleaners get help without calling the office
i23.title: Cleaner self-service support

i22.outcome: Manual work is down 50%; Commercial Manager day-to-day tasks are down to 40-50%
i22.problem: Each update, such as LMCs, needs an email composed and sent to HMK partners
i22.solution: Slack Workflow Builder form matching the usual HMK channel message format
i22.title: HMK update workflow

i32.outcome: Tech team has accepted the requirements and given a build date
i32.problem: All manual, which takes significant time and effort
i32.solution: All KPIs, data sources and desired output. Dashboard scope with the Tech team.
i32.title: Official Commercial dashboard

checklist.text: Feed all trackers to one sheet

i16.outcome: All Commercial tracking is in one sheet on current tools
i16.problem: Residential and Commercial both use one tracker
i16.solution: Separate pay adjustment, complaints, and cancellation/churn trackers feeding one sheet
i16.title: Commercial trackers

i15.outcome: New clients balance the week; core cleaners average 80% utilization
i15.problem: Imbalanced numbers of commercial bookings in a week
i15.solution: Framework showing HMK programs the available onboarding slots
i15.title: HMK slot visibility

checklist.text: Establish number of bench cleaners needed

i14.outcome: Funnel is live and bench target is set. Launch the Commercial HR funnel with a higher, faster success rate.
i14.solution: Bench cleaner number. Separate GHL hiring funnel.
i14.title: Commercial hiring

r1.mitigation: Named backup and a written agreement for coverage for a minimum period during stabilization.
r1.title: Jose is out sick while Commercial is stabilizing
